description: List an episode's chapters in order, each with its token, start (in seconds), timecode (HH:MM:SS) and title. audio_chapters says whether the MP3 has these chapters yet: up_to_date, writing (being written into it), out_of_date (it has older chapters from a dashboard change not yet written), no_audio (they are written into the MP3 once one is added), or off (the episode is set in the dashboard not to write chapters). Needs the owner, manager, or producer role.

episode.description: Episode token (UUID) or slug, as shown by fireside_list_episodes. Slugs default to the episode number but can be customised (e.g. s02e04); check fireside_list_episodes when unsure.

podcast.description: Podcast token (UUID) or slug, as shown by fireside_list_podcasts. Required unless FIRESIDE_PODCAST is configured.

name: fireside_list_chapters
title: List chapters
